Order on Board 12/03/2025 Heard Mr. Ankit Singh, learned counsel for the petitioners.
Also heard Mr. Hari Om Rai, Panel Lawyer, appearing for the State/ Respondent and perused the impugned FIR as well as charge-sheet and materials brought on record.

It has been contended by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the marriage between the respondent No. 2- Bhumika Goel (wife) and petitioner No. 1 was solemnized on 25.04.2022 as per the their rituals.
After some time of marriage some dispute arose between them.

Subsequently, on 11.11.2022, respondent No. 2 received a job offer from M/s SMEC for a consultancy position in Saurabh Zunzunwala vs State Of Chhattisgarh on 12 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183666960/

sentences.text: thereby, the respondent No. 2, only to harass the petitioner No. 1 and his family members lodged a false complaint before the Police Mahila Thana, Raipur on 03.01.2024 and registered an FIR bearing Crime No. 001/2024 .

On 24.09.2024, the Police filed the impugned final report before learned JMFC Raipur, and sequentially the petitioner were presented before the learned JMFC Raipur and the learned JMFC vide impugned order dated 24.09.2024 taken cognizance against the petitioner and proceeded with the matter.

Learned counsel for the petitioners submit that the present matter be referred to Mediation & conciliation Centre of this Court being matrimonial in nature as there are chances to compromise between the parties.
Considering the fact that the dispute arrived at between the parties is matrimonial in nature, we deem it appropriate to make an effort to get the said dispute settled by way of mediation.

In view of the above, petitioner No.1/husband shall deposit Rs. 50,000/- with the Mediation Centre of this Court within a period of one week from today and the same shall be paid to respondent No.
2/wife on her appearance before the Mediation Centre.
Parties are directed to appear before the Mediation Centre of this Court on 24.03.2025.
Learned State counsel is directed to inform the private respondent i.e. respondent No. 2 about passing of this order, so that she may appear before the Mediation Centre on the aforesaid date.
List this matter along with report of Mediation Centre before this Court on 08.04.2025.

Till the next date of listing, further criminal proceeding of Case No. 17487/24, pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Raipur arising out of the impugned FIR dated 03.01.2024 (Annexure-P/1) registered at Police Station- Mahila Thana, Raipur, Dist- Raipur (CG) under Section 498A/34 of IPC shall remain stayed.

It is made clear that in case the aforesaid amount is not deposited within the aforesaid period, the interim protection granted as above shall automatically be vacated and this petition shall stand dismissed without further reference to any Bench of this Court.

The petitioners are directed to produce the copy of the receipt before the concerned trial Court regarding payment of the said money before the Mediation Centre of this Court in pursuance of this Court's order, then only this order shall be given into effect.
It is also made clear that if any final settlement is arrived at between the parties, the aforesaid amount so deposited, shall be adjusted.

Sd/- Sd/-
 (Ravindra Kumar Agrawal) (Ramesh Sinha)
